why: Physical-device verification and before/after evidence for issue 1197. The trustworthy capacitor://localhost iPad baseline exposed a native-only synchronous resize against iPadOS's transient square rotation layout. The retained fix routes native through the existing 150 ms resize-settle debounce, restoring ADR-0089's zero-mutation ink-rotation invariant without changing any gate. A same-device Android A/B then falsified the review hypothesis that the shared debounce regresses Android's native path.

kept.note: Pre-fix native control. Every scored ink rotation performs 64 canvas backing assignments. Portrait-to-landscape has first-frame p95 151 ms and post-action p95/max 18/156 ms; landscape-to-portrait has first-frame p95 23 ms and post-action p95/max 23/111 ms. Blank directions remain within the frame gates.

Post-fix native proof. All ten scored repeats record zero ink-rotation canvas mutations. Portrait-to-landscape first-frame p95 is 20 ms and post-action p95/max is 18/22 ms; landscape-to-portrait first-frame p95 is 0 ms and post-action p95/max is 18/21 ms. Both blank directions and every undo/clear sibling pass.

Post-fix Safari sibling proof from the fresh LAN build. Portrait-to-landscape post-action p95/max is 19/20 ms with per-repeat p95 17-20 ms; landscape-to-portrait is 19/22 ms with per-repeat p95 17-22 ms. Both ink directions record zero canvas mutations and both blank directions pass. One unrelated clear-setup control straddles its first-frame/max gates at 36/37 ms; the later clear-restored control and all rotation/undo cells pass.

Post-fix physical-Android proof on the packaged Capacitor origin. All twenty scored ink rotations in both directions record zero canvas mutations. Portrait-to-landscape has first-frame p95 33.2 ms and post-action p95/max 8.4/25 ms; landscape-to-portrait has first-frame p95 34.3 ms and post-action p95/max 8.4/25 ms. Blank portrait-to-landscape is 19.9 ms first-frame p95 and 8.4/16.7 ms post-action p95/max; blank landscape-to-portrait is 35.2 ms and 8.4/25 ms. The two marginal landscape-to-portrait first-frame misses precede engine.resize, which starts about 150 ms after the action and takes 0.1-3.2 ms. No gate or allowance changed.

kept.controlPatch: Restored only handleResize's synchronous __IS_CAPACITOR__ branch from baselineHead; all other product source remained at fixHead.
kept.note: Same-device synchronous-bypass control. Blank landscape-to-portrait first-frame p95 is 34.7 ms, matching the candidate's marginal tail class rather than clearing it. Post-action p95 remains 8.4 ms, but maxima reach 58.4 ms on clear and 50 ms on ink portrait-to-landscape, versus 25 ms across the candidate's affected controls. The candidate therefore does not regress Android's already-green post-action path.

attribution.nativeBaseline: The first native resize arrives before layout and screen orientation settle. The synchronous Capacitor path adopts a 641x641 transient paper, resizes 16 normal tiles plus 16 detached repaint surfaces, and triggers the 107-156 ms WebKit presentation gaps even though engine.resize itself takes 3-5 ms.
attribution.retainedFix: The shared trailing resize debounce waits out the transient native layout just as it already does on Safari. Ink keeps its paper-sized tiles through both directions, so no backing assignment or replay reaches the rotation window.
attribution.historicalNativeArtifact: The 2026-08-25 retained artifact labeled as native used native Appium transport but appUrl http://192.168.40.53:4185/. Navigating the WebView to that web build selected the non-Capacitor debounce branch, so its zero-mutation pass did not exercise the packaged native branch corrected here.
